items.distractor_fact: අසල්වැසි උද්‍යානයේ උෂ්ණත්වය එදිනම {D}°C විය.
items.gloss_en: At the neighboring park, the temperature that same day was D°C.
items.entity_note: a different park, so its reading cannot be paired with this park's evening/morning figures

items.distractor_fact: එදිනම වෙනත් සමාගමක කොටසේ මිල ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: That same day, another company's share price was $D.
items.entity_note: a different company's stock, not the one whose open/close is being compared

items.distractor_fact: යාබද ජලාශයේ ජල මට්ටම එදින මීටර් {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: At the adjacent reservoir, the water level that day was D meters.
items.entity_note: a different reservoir, so its level does not belong to the evening/morning pair being compared

items.distractor_fact: එම දිනයේම වෙනත් බැලූනයක උස මීටර් {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: That same day, another balloon's altitude was D meters.
items.entity_note: a different balloon, not the one whose rise/descent altitudes are being compared

items.distractor_fact: එකම බැංකුවේ වෙනත් ගිණුමක මාසය ආරම්භයේ තිබූ මුදල ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: At the same bank, another account's balance at the start of the month was $D.
items.entity_note: a different account, not the one whose starting balance and spending are being compared

items.distractor_fact: වෙනත් ගිණුමකට එම සතියේම තැන්පත් කළ මුදල ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: Into another account, that same week, the amount deposited was $D.
items.entity_note: a different account, not the one whose deposit and withdrawal are being netted

items.distractor_fact: එම මාසයේම වෙනත් අංශයක ආදායම ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: That same month, another department's income was $D.
items.entity_note: a different department, not the one whose income and expenses are being netted

items.distractor_fact: එම වාරයේම වෙනත් කණ්ඩායමක් ගෝල {D}ක් රැස් කළේය.
items.gloss_en: That same season, another team scored D goals.
items.entity_note: a different team, not the one whose scored/conceded goals set the goal difference

items.distractor_fact: එම වර්ෂයේම වෙනත් ආයෝජනයකින් ලද ලාභය ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: That same year, another investment's gain was $D.
items.entity_note: a different investment, not the one whose gain and loss are being netted

items.distractor_fact: එම මාසයේම වෙනත් කම්හලක සැබෑ නිෂ්පාදනය ටොන් {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: That same month, another factory's actual production was D tons.
items.entity_note: a different factory with its own unstated target, not the one being measured against the stated target

items.distractor_fact: එම මාසයේම වෙනත් නගරයක සැබෑ වර්ෂාපතනය මිලිමීටර් {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: That same month, another city's actual rainfall was D millimeters.
items.entity_note: a different city with its own unstated forecast, not the one being measured against the stated forecast

items.distractor_fact: එම කාර්තුවේම වෙනත් ශාඛාවක සැබෑ විකුණුම් ප්‍රමාණය ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: That same quarter, another branch's actual sales were $D.
items.entity_note: a different branch with its own unstated target, not the one being measured against the stated target

items.distractor_fact: වෙනත් තරගාවලියක ක්‍රීඩකයෙක් අවසන් වටයේදී පහර {D}ක් ගැසුවේය.
items.gloss_en: In another tournament, a player took D strokes in the final round.
items.entity_note: a different tournament with its own unstated par, not the round being measured against the stated par

items.distractor_fact: වෙනත් මාර්ගයක දුම්රියක පැමිණි වේලාව, දිනයේ ආරම්භයේ සිට ගණන් කළ විට, මිනිත්තු {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: On a different line, another train's arrival time, counted from the start of the day, was minute D.
items.entity_note: a different train on a different line, with its own unstated timetable, not the one measured against the stated schedule

items.distractor_fact: යාබද ගොඩනැගිල්ලේ, එහිම මහල් අංකනයට අනුව, මගේ මිතුරාගේ මහල මහල් {D} වේ.
items.gloss_en: In the adjacent building, according to that building's own floor numbering, my friend's floor is floor D.
items.entity_note: a different building with its own floor-numbering reference, not the one whose floor is measured against its own ground floor

items.distractor_fact: එම වැඩසටහනේම වෙනත් සහභාගිවන්නෙකුගේ බර වැඩසටහන ආරම්භයේදී කිලෝග්‍රෑම් {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: In that same program, another participant's weight at the start was D kilograms.
items.entity_note: a different participant, not the one whose before/after weights are being compared

items.distractor_fact: එදිනම වූ වෙනත් තරගයක කණ්ඩායමක් ගෝල {D}ක් ලබා ගත්තේය.
items.gloss_en: In another match that same day, a team scored D goals.
items.entity_note: a different match and team, not the red or blue team being compared

items.distractor_fact: වෙනත් තරගයක (හීට් එකක) ධාවකයෙකුගේ අවසන් කළ වේලාව තත්පර {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: In another race (heat), a runner's finish time was second D.
items.entity_note: a different heat and runner, not Anusha or Nishani being compared

items.distractor_fact: එම කාර්තුවේම තුන්වන සමාගමක ආදායම ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: That same quarter, a third company's revenue was $D.
items.entity_note: a third company, not the first or second company being compared

items.distractor_fact: ක්‍රීඩාවේදීම වෙනත් ක්‍රීඩකයෙක් ලකුණු {D}ක් ලබා ගත්තේය.
items.gloss_en: In that same game, another player scored D points.
items.entity_note: a different player, not Kamal or Sunil being compared
